name: aura-visualizer-3D
description: Visualize your codebase in 3D directly in VSCode — interactive dependency graph with force-directed layout

languageModelTools.name: aura_resolve_context
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Given a natural-language task description, return the most relevant files in the analyzed codebase, ranked, with exact path:line anchors, metrics and a 1-hop dependency neighborhood. Use this to orient yourself in the codebase before making edits.

limit.description: Maximum number of files to return (default: 10)

languageModelTools.name: aura_search_docs
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Full-text search across project documentation (Markdown, text, reStructuredText). Returns top matching chunks with file, section, line and excerpt. Use this to answer questions about how the project works, conventions, or install steps.

limit.description: Maximum number of chunks to return (default: 10)

languageModelTools.name: aura_get_hotspots
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Get the most at-risk files in the codebase, ranked by Aura's repository-relative risk score (percentile-based: complexity, fan-in/out, cycles, dead code, git churn) with written reasons per file. Raw metric sorts remain available via sort_by.

sort_by.description: Sort criterion: risk (default — percentile-based score with written reasons), impact, complexity, fan_in, or lines

languageModelTools.name: aura_find_path
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Find the shortest dependency path between two files in the codebase. Returns null if no path exists.

languageModelTools.name: aura_search_symbols
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Search for functions, classes, interfaces, methods, or other symbols by name. Returns symbol name, kind, file and line.

kind.description: Optional filter: function, method, class, struct, enum, macro, export, interface, trait, type_alias

chatParticipants.name: aura
chatParticipants.description: Ask Aura about codebase architecture, hotspots, impact and dependencies.

auraVisualizer.maxFiles.description: Maximum number of files to analyze

auraVisualizer.autoRefresh.description: Automatically refresh visualization when files are saved

auraVisualizer.followEditor.description: Fly the 3D camera to the file of the active editor. Manual camera movement pauses following until the 👁 toolbar button is clicked again.

auraVisualizer.notifyOnScan.description: Show a summary notification after a full codebase analysis (files, cycles, dead exports, hotspots)

enumDescriptions: Render graph edges as straight lines
Render graph edges as curved lines
auraVisualizer.linkStyle.description: Style of edges in the 3D graph: straight lines or curved lines

auraVisualizer.linkCurvature.description: Curvature amount when linkStyle is 'curved' (0 = straight, 1 = highly curved)

enumDescriptions: Soft additive sphere halo around the selected node (default)
Real post-processing bloom (UnrealBloomPass) applied to the whole scene
auraVisualizer.selectedNodeEffect.description: Visual effect used to highlight the selected node

auraVisualizer.bloomThreshold.description: Bloom luminance threshold when selectedNodeEffect is 'bloom'

auraVisualizer.riskWindow.description: Git history window (in days) used by the Risk Map: churn, scoring and written explanations

auraVisualizer.complexityTrendThreshold.description: Complexity points per 30 days that flag a file as degrading in the Trend column / Risk dashboard

auraVisualizer.riskCentrality.description: Use PageRank centrality instead of fan-in in the risk score (optional V2-16 factor)

auraVisualizer.rotateSpeed.description: Rotation speed when dragging the 3D graph (1 = default, 5 = fastest)

auraVisualizer.flightSpeed.description: Pilot mode (free flight) base speed multiplier — the base speed scales with the scene size

auraVisualizer.flightSmoothing.description: Pilot mode acceleration/damping time constant in seconds (low = snappy, high = floaty)

auraVisualizer.mouseSensitivity.description: Pilot mode mouse-look sensitivity (radians per pixel)

auraVisualizer.invertY.description: Pilot mode: invert the mouse Y axis (moving the mouse up looks down)

auraVisualizer.savedQueries.description: Globally saved Aura Query Language favorites (shared across workspaces)

steps.title: Open the 3D Visualizer
steps.description:
Press ``Ctrl+Shift+A`` (or ``Cmd+Shift+A`` on Mac) to open the interactive 3D graph of your codebase.

[Open Visualizer](command:auraVisualizer.open)

steps.title: Explore the Graph
steps.description:
**Click** a node to see file details. **Double-click** to open the file in the editor. **Right-click** to pin focus on a file and its neighbors.

Use the mouse wheel to zoom and drag to rotate.

steps.title: Switch Between Views
steps.description:
Use the **tab bar** to switch between 9 views: 3D Graph, Treemap, Matrix (DSM), Chord Diagram, Metrics Dashboard, Timeline Chart, File Table, Risk Dashboard and Temporal Co-change.

Each view offers a different perspective on your architecture.

steps.title: Use Heatmaps
steps.description:
Click the heatmap buttons in the toolbar to color nodes by **Complexity**, **Cognitive**, **Fan-in**, **Fan-out**, **Lines of Code**, **Churn**, **Co-change**, **Last Modified**, or **Communities**.

Spot hotspots at a glance!

steps.title: Find Dependency Paths
steps.description:
Click the **Path** button in the toolbar, then click two nodes to find the shortest dependency path between them.

Great for understanding how files are connected.

steps.title: Read a Function at a Glance
steps.description:
Click the **⑂** button next to a function in the detail panel to open its **flowchart**: branches, loops, switch cases and try/catch, built on demand from the source AST.

Click any step to jump to its line, drill into calls, and export the chart as SVG.

steps.title: Detect Dead Code & Cycles
steps.description:
Press **X** to highlight unused exports (dead code). Framework/test exemptions remain visible with their reason and can be edited from **Settings → Dead code exemptions**. Press **C** to reveal circular dependencies. Press **O** to find orphan files.

Clean up your codebase!

steps.title: Travel Through Git History
steps.description:
Use the **timeline bar** at the bottom to navigate your project's commit history. Changed files light up in yellow at each step.

Watch your architecture evolve!

steps.title: AI Integration (@aura, MCP, Export)
steps.description:
Mention **@aura** in VS Code Chat, query the built-in **MCP server** (17 deterministic tools), or use **📤 Export** for a guided Markdown/JSON AI context with selectable sections and a token budget.

Works with GitHub Copilot and other MCP clients.

steps.title: Keyboard Shortcuts
steps.description:
Use single-key shortcuts: **F** recenter, **H** heatmaps, **D** DAG, **X** dead code, **C** cycles, **1-5** depth, **←→** timeline.

All features are one key away!
